questions.question: The "Pouch of Douglas" is also known as the:
questions.detail: This is the most dependent portion of the peritoneal cavity where fluid or blood first accumulates.

questions.question: The "Space of Retzius" is located:
choices: Between the pubic symphysis and the bladder
questions.detail: This is a pre-peritoneal space often containing fat or hematomas following surgery.

questions.question: On ultrasound, a "full bladder" is required for which type of pelvic exam?
questions.detail: The bladder serves as an acoustic window to see the deeper pelvic organs.

questions.question: Which of the following is an advantage of "Transvaginal" ultrasound?
choices: Higher spatial resolution of the uterus and ovaries
Better visualization of the upper abdomen
questions.detail: The proximity to the organs allows the use of higher-frequency probes.

questions.question: "Pelvic inflammatory disease" (PID) frequently presents with which imaging sign on ultrasound?
questions.detail: Inflammation leads to wall thickening and increased Doppler flow in the adnexa.
